note: Two liquids layered (GAME_SPEC §6, §13.7, Stage 47): a 250 mL beaker of green nickel sulfate solution (0.8 mol/kg, 1.12 g/cm3) over blue copper sulfate solution (1.4 mol/kg, 1.22 g/cm3), 80 g of water in each; the lab's burner in the cabinet. The denser stays under the lighter; across their boundary each diffuses into the other, a gradient a few millimetres wide in a day.
